title: Kore ServiceRelease
description: The release file of one app record, <service>.release.json, written only by the platform. It carries the image digests, the source commit and the attestation references. Flag state is not here: the platform holds it in the separate per-app state file (ADR 0169). Every object is closed (additionalProperties false).

name.description: the service name, equal to the file name without .release.json

commit.description: the 40-character lowercase hex application source commit

components.description: frontend, bff or both; a release carries at least one

digest.description: the image digest: sha256, a colon, then 64 lowercase hex characters

attestation.description: an OCI reference of the form <registry>/<repository>@sha256:<64 hex characters>

rejected.description: digests the platform must not deploy again (a rollback returns to a digest that is not on this list); a list never holds the component's own digest (ADR 0172)
